using MissionPlanner.Controls;

using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Drawing;
using System.Globalization;

using System.Windows.Forms;
namespace TestSupport { internal static class Run { internal static readonly List<string> Writes = new List<string>(); } }
namespace System.Windows.Forms {
    [Flags] public enum AnchorStyles { Top=1, Bottom=2, Left=4, Right=8 }
    public enum DockStyle { Fill }
    public sealed class Padding { public Padding(int a,int b,int c,int d) {} }
    public sealed class ColumnStyle {}
    public sealed class RowStyle {}
    public class Control {
        public class Items : List<Control> { public void Add(Control c,int col,int row) { Add(c); } }
        public readonly Items Controls = new Items();
        public bool Enabled, AutoSize;
        public string Name, Text;
        public int Width, Height, TabIndex;
        public Point Location;
        public Size Size;
        public Padding Padding;
        public AnchorStyles Anchor;
        public DockStyle Dock;
        public Font Font;
        public int Bottom { get { return Location.Y+Height; } }
        public void SuspendLayout() {}
        public void ResumeLayout() {}
        public void ResumeLayout(bool perform) {}
        public void PerformLayout() {}
    }
    public class TableLayoutPanel : Control {
        public readonly List<ColumnStyle> ColumnStyles = new List<ColumnStyle>();
        public readonly List<RowStyle> RowStyles = new List<RowStyle>();
        public int ColumnCount, RowCount;
    }
    public class Panel : Control {}
    public class Label : Control {}
    public class CheckBox : Control {
        bool check;
        public event EventHandler CheckedChanged;
        public bool Checked {
            get { return check; }
            set { if (check==value) return; check=value; if(CheckedChanged!=null) CheckedChanged(this, EventArgs.Empty); }
        }
        public void SimulateUserClick() { Checked = !Checked; }
    }
}

namespace MissionPlanner.Utilities {
    public static class ParameterMetaDataConstants { public const string DisplayName="n", Description="d"; }
    public static class ParameterMetaDataRepository {
        public static string GetParameterMetaData(string k,string t,string f) { return t + ":" + k; }
        public static List<KeyValuePair<int,string>> GetParameterBitMaskInt(string k, string f) {
            return new List<KeyValuePair<int,string>> { new KeyValuePair<int,string>(0,"one"),new KeyValuePair<int,string>(1,"two"),new KeyValuePair<int,string>(2,"four") };
        }
    }
}
public static class MAVLink {
    public enum MAV_PARAM_TYPE { REAL32, INT8, INT16, INT32 }
    public class Item { public float Value; public MAV_PARAM_TYPE TypeAP; }
    public class MAVLinkParamList : Dictionary<string,Item> {}
}
public static class Probe {
    static readonly List<string> pending = new List<string>();
    static int cases;
    static void Control_ValueChanged(object sender,string key,string value) { pending.Add(key+":"+value); }
    static MissionPlanner.Controls.MavlinkCheckBoxBitMask Init(float initial = 0) {
        var ctl=new MissionPlanner.Controls.MavlinkCheckBoxBitMask();
        var parameters=new MAVLink.MAVLinkParamList { { "SYNTHETIC_MASK", new MAVLink.Item{Value=initial,TypeAP=MAVLink.MAV_PARAM_TYPE.REAL32} } };
        ctl.setup("SYNTHETIC_MASK", parameters);
        return ctl;
    }
    static void Refresh(MissionPlanner.Controls.MavlinkCheckBoxBitMask ctl, float value) {
        var items = new[]{ctl};
        // Inject the exact three live reuse statements from ConfigFriendlyParams.cs here.
        /*EXACT_REUSE*/
    }
    static void Clear() { TestSupport.Run.Writes.Clear(); pending.Clear(); }
    static void Equal<T>(T actual,T expected,string name) {
        if(!EqualityComparer<T>.Default.Equals(actual,expected)) throw new Exception(name+": expected="+expected+" observed="+actual);
    }
    static void Report(string name,float value,string expectedWrites,string expectedPending,MissionPlanner.Controls.MavlinkCheckBoxBitMask ctl) {
        string w=string.Join(",",TestSupport.Run.Writes), p=string.Join(",",pending);
        Equal(ctl.Value,value,name+" displayed");
        Equal(w,expectedWrites,name+" writes");
        Equal(p,expectedPending,name+" pending");
        Console.WriteLine(name+" displayed="+ctl.Value+" writes=["+w+"] pending=["+p+"]");
        cases++;
    }
    static int Main() {
        try { RunCases(); return 0; }
        catch (Exception error) { Console.Error.WriteLine(error.Message); return 1; }
    }
    static void RunCases() {
        System.Threading.Thread.CurrentThread.CurrentCulture=CultureInfo.InvariantCulture;
        Report("setup-nonzero",5,"","",Init(5));
        var ctl=Init();
        Report("setup",0,"","",ctl);
        ctl.ValueChanged += Control_ValueChanged;
        Refresh(ctl,7);
        Report("reused-refresh-0-to-7",7,"","",ctl);
        Clear();
        Refresh(ctl,7);
        Report("same-value-refresh",7,"","",ctl);
        Clear();
        Refresh(ctl,0);
        Report("reused-refresh-7-to-0",0,"","",ctl);
        Clear(); ctl.Value=3;
        Report("refresh-with-subscriber",3,"","",ctl);
        Clear(); ((CheckBox)ctl.panel1.Controls[2]).SimulateUserClick();
        Report("user-toggle-with-subscriber",7,"","SYNTHETIC_MASK:7",ctl);
        Clear(); ctl.ValueChanged -= Control_ValueChanged; ((CheckBox)ctl.panel1.Controls[1]).SimulateUserClick();
        Report("user-toggle-without-subscriber",5,"4:5:SYNTHETIC_MASK:5","",ctl);
        Clear(); ctl.ValueChanged += Control_ValueChanged;
        var chk=(CheckBox)ctl.panel1.Controls[0]; EventHandler bad=(sender,e)=> {throw new InvalidOperationException("synthetic");};
        chk.CheckedChanged+=bad;
        bool seen=false;
        try { ctl.Value=4; } catch(InvalidOperationException e){seen=(e.Message=="synthetic");}
        chk.CheckedChanged-=bad;
        Equal(seen,true,"external fault injected");
        Report("setter-fault",4,"","",ctl);
        Clear(); ((CheckBox)ctl.panel1.Controls[1]).SimulateUserClick();
        Report("user-toggle-after-fault",6,"","SYNTHETIC_MASK:6",ctl);
        Console.WriteLine("PASS cases="+cases);
    }
}
